orders.title: Light the Brazier
orders.blurb: Six Gem Shards, Keeper. That brazier has been cold since the last keeper fled — light it, and I will part with something I have kept far too long.

orders.title: Warm the Long Hearth
orders.blurb: Your little dragon keeps coughing up shards — good. Forge me THREE Flame Gems and the hall will be warm by supper.

orders.title: Catch the Moonwater
orders.blurb: The basin on the high ground fills whether anyone watches it or not. Three drops make a vial, three vials make Moonwater — bring me one, and I will show you what the moon does with borrowed light.

orders.title: Craft the Radiant Centerpiece
orders.blurb: One Radiant Gem. One. Merge three Flame Gems into something the old court would have stopped talking to look at.

orders.title: Fill the Keeper's Hoard
orders.blurb: An encore, Keeper — three Radiant Gems. A proper hoard for a proper Keep, and proof enough for anyone still watching.

orders.title: Bank a Signal Fire
orders.blurb: You came a long way to stand on nine feet of ice. Bind me two faggots of that driftwood and I will light something you can steer by — then the coast is yours to walk. The door comes later, if I like what you do with it.

orders.title: Feed the Northern Dragons
orders.blurb: Mine eat pitch, not berries. Nothing grows here, so the fire has to be built before it can be fed — a woodpile first, then three cakes of it. That is the whole north in one errand.

orders.title: Salvage the Wrecks
orders.blurb: Two lashed frames. You will want to live under something eventually, and out here that means turning over what the sea has already finished with.

orders.title: Spin the Light-Fast Spindles
orders.blurb: Two spindles, wound tight. My sister catches light and keeps it in glass; I spin it into thread and it keeps something warm. Bring me these and I will tell you what I have been keeping.

repeatable.title: More Gem Shards
repeatable.blurb: The brazier is hungry again. Eight Gem Shards, if your dragons would be so kind.

repeatable.title: More Flame Gems
repeatable.blurb: Two Flame Gems for the gallery alcoves. I want the light back in that corridor.

repeatable.title: More Dragon Rubies
repeatable.blurb: Five Dragon Rubies. Ask the red one — she hoards them anyway.

repeatable.title: Another Radiant Gem
repeatable.blurb: Another Radiant Gem, Keeper. The Keep can never be too bright, and I sleep better for it.

repeatable.title: More Drift Spars
repeatable.blurb: Eight spars off the tide line. The fire does not keep itself.

repeatable.title: More Pitch Cakes
repeatable.blurb: Two more cakes. They have been out in it all night and they are not sentimental about who feeds them.

repeatable.title: More Frost Threads
repeatable.blurb: Five threads. I spin in the evenings. It is not a hobby.

repeatable.title: Another Black Ember
repeatable.blurb: One black ember. Keep it away from the thread, and away from me.
